summary: Phase 7 release prep verified independently. The GL lifecycle works on mobile web (375x667, SwiftShader): hidden gives {suspended:1,ready:1,live:false} with phase 'paused' and distance frozen; visible gives {suspended:1,ready:2,live:true}; the pause menu is shown, Resume continues the run with the 3D scene re-rendered, a second background/resume cycle works (ready 3), and there were no page errors. Regression: menu, characters/boards/worlds, shop, missions, daily, settings and leaderboard all load, and the run reaches revive and then game over. Config check: `expo config --type public` shows package com.velactra.rushrivals, versionCode 1, version 1.0.0, targetSdkVersion 36 (compileSdkVersion 37) and blockedPermissions. Admin reply to RR-DEMO01 returns email_sent=false with email_error='undeliverable_recipient', and the reason is stored on the reply. The contact form to delivered@resend.dev returned confirmation_email_sent=false on 2 tries because the upstream Emergent email proxy replied 429 code 'rate_limited'. This is an upstream quota hit after the main agent's earlier real sends, not a code defect. The reason 'rate_limited' was recorded.

minor.issue: Real send not confirmed in this run: the upstream proxy returned 429 rate_limited twice, 60s apart, and the response had confirmation_email_sent=false. Main agent had already observed 202 deliveries. Retest later when the proxy quota resets.

The response does not include confirmation_email_error. It is stored only on the ticket. That is fine if it is meant to keep the reason away from the public; the review request implied it is returned.
Proxy 429 'rate_limited' is mapped to the generic 502 email_failed and logged as ERROR. Consider treating it like daily_limit_reached (503 email_unavailable, WARNING).

action_items: Optional: treat proxy 429 'rate_limited' as a transient case (503 email_unavailable, warning-level log) in mailer.send_email.
Optional: decide whether the contact response should expose confirmation_email_error. Right now it is stored on the ticket only.
critical_code_review_comments: The glLifecycle state machine is simple and correct. The 'restore' event only goes back to live while the app is still active.

success_rate.backend: 50% (1/2; the failure is caused by the upstream proxy rate limit)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 contact tickets for delivered@resend.dev (name 'TEST_ P7') and 1 TEST_ reply on RR-DEMO01. This used 2 of the 5/hour contact quota for this IP.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the lifecycle and regression check with: python3 /app/tests/rr3d/p7_t1_lifecycle.py. Email tests are in /app/backend/tests/test_phase7_email.py; the owner TOTP secret is in /tmp/rr_admin_totp.json. The Emergent email proxy can return 429 rate_limited after a burst of real sends.
